# What do you really make on a cord of firewood?

> Free calculator for firewood sellers: what a cord costs you, how many hours it takes, your profit per cord and per hour, the price per cord and face cord you need to earn a wage, and what delivery distance does to it. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/firewood-profit-calculator/)
